services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: We Fly the Highest on the Lake! 30 minutes - 1 hour on the Parasail Boat Description Come enjoy breathtaking views while parasailing over Lake Tahoe. It’s fun, safe, and addicting! We use a US Coast Guard Certified Vessel. We have 3 different heights which vary from 400′ / 800′ / 1000' above the lake. We have daily flights weather permitting. Tandem rides may be required. All parasail rides are weather permitting. Parasailing must be booked with at least 2 people per tour. We require at least 2 people in the air at any time and we can do up to 3 people. The combined Thrill of a lifetime!

services.name: Buoy Mooring Rentals
services.desc: Important Information You need to have your own mooring line that is the appropriate size for your boat, we do not provide one for you. The suggested length of line we recommend is the length of your boat. Before and after taxi operating hours, we offer a tender boat, for self-service, to shuttle back and forth. You will responsible for returning the metal skiff promptly for others to use, as well as any damages that may occur to the skiff, other boats, and the dock. The taxi boat will operate under safe conditions and ALL passengers under 12 are required to wear a life Moor your own boat!

quotes.author: Meander781536
quotes.text: Oh my goodness such a blast!! Mark and Pete were so much fun! My mom wanted to go 1000' up for her 80th birthday, so she, my nephew and I went - absolutely breathtaking and the guys made it so special and such an absolute blast! They took tons of pictures for us (that turned out great!) and we also opted to rent their GoPro for great shots (getting to take the video card with us. We now want to come back and rent the entire boat in September with more family - super memorable and amazing!!

We reserved a 20’ boat for a half day (3 hours paid, 4th hour free). Reservations were very easy to make and are recommended. We picked a very busy time so it did take about an hour to get checked in and on the boat. Our 4 hours didn’t start until we were on the boat. Staff was very friendly and knowledgeable. We are repeat customers and they always treat us right!

quotes.author: Kanchan
quotes.text: The entire experience from signing up for the ride till hand off was well orchestrated. The signing up process was smooth and most of it was online. The boat was clean and we were given a proper guidance of the boat operations. The drive into the Emerald bay was memorable.

quotes.author: Billybean97
quotes.text: Everything was extremely smooth. Reserved a pontoon online, check-in was easy and took exactly how long they estimated it would. The pontoon was even nicer than I expected and everyone was super friendly. Couldn't have asked for a better time.

Everything was top-notch. The folks doing the paperwork were efficient, informative, and worked quickly. The guys dealing with the boats were friendly and did a good job running over the boat operations. Highly recommended.
Extremely efficient check in process and helpful staff. They had all the boats ready for us upon arrival and explained everything we needed to do for the trip. Easy to get to and plenty of selection.
